title: Positive: access control, journeys, dependencies, secrets and production checks hold on re-test
steps: Re-ran the 11-05 suites and new probes on the local stack; production read-only checks.
actual: Two-account 9/9; order journey 24/24; export and deletion 10/10 (was 9/10); all 20 new endpoints enforce sign-in, ownership and admin roles (seller saves hide saver identity; verification documents answer 404 for missing and not-yours; private files need a signature); 0 frontend calls to missing routes (was 16); 0 known vulnerabilities in production dependencies; 12 history-scan hits all placeholders, no secrets in the client bundle; production checks 23/23; no third-party requests or cookies before sign-in on public pages; axe clean on 40/41 of 50 pages, no horizontal scroll at 320 px; skip link, landmarks, visible focus, reduced motion and forced colours OK; refresh tokens rotate on use.
